slides.texte_overlay:
Advice I'd scream at my
22 year old self

1.
Learn to cook five real meals.
Takeout every night costs
more than money. It costs
you the skill of taking care
of yourself.

2.
Call your parents more.
They're getting older
while you're getting busy.
You won't get those calls back.

3.
Train your body now.
The habits you build at 22
are the body you live in at 40.

4.
Read more than you scroll.
Ten minutes of learning a day
will put you years ahead
of everyone who didn't.
slides.texte_sophia:
4.
Read more than you scroll.
Ten minutes of learning a day,
on the Sophia app or in a book,
puts you years ahead.

slides.texte_overlay:
5.
Stop comparing timelines.
Someone's 22 is someone
else's 30. Run your own race.

6.
Pick friends who push you.
The ones who ask "what are you
building?" not "where are we
drinking?"

7.
Learn to sit with boredom.
The men who can't be bored
never build anything.
